quarterly_data.quarter: CoreWeave press release: CoreWeave Launches the CoreWeave Zero Trust AI Framework, (10-21-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: CoreWeave launched the CoreWeave Zero Trust AI Framework, a customer-controlled security model with six layers: Zero Key Access (Remote Key Encryption with customers' own keys), Zero Node Access (Support Access Management), Zero Trust Infrastructure (attestation using hardware roots of trust), Zero In-Use Access, Zero Model Data and Zero Trust Network Encryption (IEEE 802.1AE MACsec on its backbone). CoreWeave says NVIDIA HGX Rubin NVL8 is coming to CoreWeave Cloud in Q4 2026; it intends to extend NVIDIA's third-generation Confidential Computing across CPUs, GPUs and the NVLink fabric, including on HGX Rubin NVL8, beginning with select bare metal environments, and to support the NVIDIA OpenShell Reference Architecture (Rubin GPUs and Vera CPUs). CoreWeave says it does not use customer prompts, training data, model weights or outputs to train or improve its own models.
quarterly_data.figure: six layers; HGX Rubin NVL8 on CoreWeave Cloud in Q4 2026
